European venture capital firm redalpine has closed its eighth early-stage fund at an oversubscribed $250m, securing commitments from institutional investors including Aviva Investors, Flexstone Partners and German development bank KfW.

French private markets major Ardian has raised €1bn for its specialist semiconductor investment platform, with investors from the Middle East and North Africa providing 41% of the capital.

Defence technology company Shield AI has agreed to acquire counter-drone radar developer Echodyne for up to $5.3bn, alongside a $2.5bn financing package involving Blackstone, JPMorgan and venture capital investors.

Nigeria's pension industry is developing a $750m infrastructure investment fund which aims to secure $600m from domestic pension funds, as part of a UK-backed initiative to channel more institutional capital into energy, transport and digital infrastructure.

Finnish private markets investor Certior Capital has reached a first close for its third European small-cap private equity fund, amid shifting its investment focus more heavily towards co-investments alongside independent sponsors, search funds and other specialist dealmakers.

Southeast European growth equity investor BlackPeak Capital has reached a €125m first close for its second regional fund, reaching roughly the total raised by its predecessor vehicle in the strategy.

European mid-market infrastructure investor Cube Infrastructure Managers has reached a €587m first close for its fourth flagship fund, which is eyeing up a €1.5bn target.

Atlantic Bridge co-founder and managing partner Brian Long is leaving the €1.4bn growth equity firm to establish a new technology investment fund focused on the US market.

The $135.2bn-managing Virginia Retirement System is planning to increase its private equity co-investments to more than $750m a year and expand its use of continuation vehicles.

Proterra Investment Partners has raised a target-beating $680m for its third private credit fund targeting food and beverage businesses, taking commitments across the fund and its companion vehicles to more than $1bn.
